title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyperparameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: Increasing the value of lambda (λ) in ridge regression affects the estimated parameters. It adds a penalty to the size of the coefficients, which can lead to smaller parameter estimates.

title: Parameter Change with Lambda
text: As lambda (λ) increases, the penalty on the size of the coefficients increases. This typically results in smaller values for the estimated parameters.
